name: Hartalega Holdings Berhad
summary: Hartalega Holdings Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and sale of gloves. The company offers latex, nitrile, polychloroprene, and polyisoprene gloves; and COATS colloidal oatmeal coated glove, AMG antimicrobial glove, BDG biodegradable glove, and polychloroprene examination glove. It is also involved in the leasing of properties; and research and development of automation systems. The company serves healthcare, food, dental, industrial, life sciences, general cleaning and housekeeping, safety and security, spa and beauty salon, tattoo, and veterinary markets.
